inspection: Labeled sheets and full-size original/front/side, candidate front/side/top/oblique/low-front views; final comparison board.
findings: Original has broad ivory side cheeks with downward pointed tips; former backing hid much of the ivory. Corrected layer order and rebuilt the existing quad grids.
Original central nose is narrower and more angular than previous capsule. Reused center spine, dark external head casing and lower split lens components.
First checkpoint head read as a flat plate. Advanced the casing and folded existing columns into a center recess with paired shoulder ribs; retained enclosed depth.
Broader trapezoidal upper cowling follows original planform while retaining saddle-end termination and lower waist.
Accepted legs, rider contacts, cargo and recreated hoses remain in place.
limits: Original fused design reconstructed as clean separate forms; not a point-for-point copy or final artistic acceptance. Existing normal/AO reused; local texture density changes where forms stretch. Static review, without animation or Unity proof.
